name: vaultia-skills
description: All Vaultia skills: product requirements and architecture requirements for software teams.

interface.longDescription: Requirements skills for software teams. product-requirements turns an idea into a testable PRD (WHAT and WHY); architecture-requirements turns the PRD into a system design with APIs, data models, non-functional requirements, and ADRs (HOW and CONSTRAINTS). Both work step by step with you: they propose options, show diagrams, and ask one decision at a time.
defaultPrompt: Write a PRD for a personal expense tracking app
Turn this PRD into a technical design
Review this requirements document for gaps
